variant.name: seated bilateral anterior lat pulldown
variant.grip: pronated straight/angled bar; width and individual arm path must be recorded per reference
variant.path: overhead to anterior upper-chest region; no behind-neck extrapolation
variant.excluded: No claim for every grip, machine, individual ROM, injury status or force distribution.

evidenceClasses.literature: Published anatomical/kinematic evidence with source ID; evidence for elevation is not a calibrated pulldown trajectory.
evidenceClasses.directVideoObservation: Requires named external recording, camera, timestamps and visible landmarks. None acquired or measured by this biomechanics author.
evidenceClasses.anatomyConstraint: Attachment continuity and compatible relative frames, interpreted with anatomy.md; not measured strain or a diagnostic limit.
evidenceClasses.authoringAssumption: Declared digital convention or qualitative keypose proposal requiring future calibration; not a human measurement.
evidenceClasses.runtimeObservation: Read-only source-code observation at sourceCommit; current implementation is not biological ground truth.

canonicalGltf.origin: Model-local origin; landmark coordinates must specify rest/posed state. Do not imply anatomical pelvis origin.

blenderAuthoring.vectorsAndRotations: Convert vectors by the same orthonormal basis; rotations by basis conjugation. Never apply position translation to directions.

rawSourceImport.observedVertexOperation: After Blender glTF import: (x,z,-y)/1000 + bodyTranslation. This operates on imported Blender coordinates, not directly on raw glTF file arrays.
rawSourceImport.unitsClaim: Division by1000 is the current source-size convention; verify against source dimensions and provenance rather than inferring subject stature.

currentDisplayTransform.warning: Compare geometry/clearance in a declared frame. Display-scaled scene distances differ from model metres.

localFrames.definition: Future landmark-based frame: superior and anterior directions from documented thorax landmarks, orthonormalized; declare origin and handedness. Current Thorax control is a manually estimated rig segment, not this anatomical calibration.
localFrames.uncertainty: No source skeletal landmark annotation, landmark error bars or subject calibration supplied; null angular precision.

localFrames.definition: Use a separately tracked scapular frame relative to thorax; name the chosen axes and rotation sequence. Do not label one world-axis control rotation as all three anatomical rotations.
localFrames.uncertainty: Muscle meshes do not identify bony landmarks or joint centre accurately; current Scapula head/tail cannot substitute for digitized scapular landmarks.

localFrames.definition: Long axis from elbow midpoint toward head centre; axial rotation requires epicondylar reference. Report humerus relative to scapula separately from humerus relative to thorax.
localFrames.uncertainty: Two-bone IK determines segment direction but does not independently establish humeral axial rotation or glenohumeral contact.

localFrames.definition: Separate elbow flexion, forearm pronation and wrist orientation; original source hand geometry must remain identifiable.
localFrames.uncertainty: Bar alignment and contact-marker alignment alone do not establish palm contact, finger closure or wrist-neutral anatomy.

keyposeConvention.phaseUnit: percent of complete repetition, not muscle activation or percentage ROM
keyposeConvention.timing: 0 top;25 descending;50 bottom turnaround;75 ascending;100 top return. Equal spacing is a reusable capture convention, not measured human timing.
keyposeConvention.phaseToCurrentSeconds: phasePercent /100 *4 only for current4-second digital clip
keyposeConvention.reversibility: Return should be smooth; 25/75 need not be identical in real movement. Current symmetric cosine must not be treated as observed human symmetry.

keyposes.label: top/start
keyposes.humerus: elevated relative to thorax; exact elevation plane and axial rotation uncalibrated
keyposes.elbow: more extended than at bottom; no compulsory locked joint
keyposes.scapula: Allow elevation-related upward rotation/posterior tilt; do not pin shoulder blades permanently down/back. Exact orientation depends on variant and subject.
keyposes.trunk: supported seated setup; selected stable lean must be documented

keyposes.label: pull/descent
keyposes.bar: travels down in front of head toward upper chest
keyposes.humerus: elevation decreases; adduction/extension combination depends on grip and plane
keyposes.elbow: flexion increases as elbows move down
keyposes.scapula: Moves relative to thorax; direction/timing must be observed, no forced constant scapulohumeral ratio
keyposes.trunk: avoid using a changing trunk swing as a substitute for arm motion

keyposes.label: bottom/turnaround
keyposes.bar: anterior upper-chest region; individual reach/contact not prescribed as fixed distance
keyposes.humerus: less elevated than top; no invented posterior elbow endpoint
keyposes.elbow: more flexed than top, with wrist/bar geometry separately checked
keyposes.scapula: Compatible with thorax and humeral orientation; do not require maximal retraction/depression
keyposes.trunk: remains stable; smooth change of direction

keyposes.label: controlled return
keyposes.bar: rises in front of head under control
keyposes.scapula: Can resume elevation-related upward rotation/posterior tilt; no rigid fixed-ratio interpolation

keyposes.label: top/end
keyposes.bar: returns to same intended start region
keyposes.humerus: returns to selected elevated start pose
keyposes.scapula: Returns to compatible start orientation without discontinuity

scapulohumeralConstraints.literature: Arm elevation involves scapular upward rotation and posterior tilt with variability of internal/external rotation, and combined sternoclavicular/acromioclavicular motion.
scapulohumeralConstraints.inferenceForAuthoring: Scapula, humerus and thorax need compatible relative movement. Lowering from an elevated arm should not be implemented by freezing all scapular tissue to thorax.
notEstablished: A numeric pulldown shoulder/scapula angle curve
Exact humeral axial rotation from upper-arm direction
Scapular motion reconstructed from muscle colour or silhouette alone

cameraPresets.projection: Record perspective FOV and viewport in each capture; no image-based angle measurement without camera calibration.
cameraPresets.origin: First three copied from current capture adapter for reproducibility; extra views are proposed authoring diagnostics.
cameraPresets.occlusion: Record any hidden machine meshes. Back view with machine hidden is an inspection aid and must not imply collision clearance.
cameraPresets.gripTracking: Target each actual palm landmark and bar at every phase; fixed top-position grip camera is insufficient for full-rep clearance.

digitalVerificationTolerances.status: proposed numerical reproducibility checks, not anatomical acceptance limits

checks.rationale: Double-precision orthonormal basis conversion should introduce negligible numerical drift; does not cover asset/export rounding.

checks.scope: same sampled vertex after identical seek in deterministic digital playback
checks.rationale: Detect stale matrices or seek state. Human repetitions need not repeat within this value.

digitalVerificationTolerances.deformationAcceptance: Attachment continuity, severe compression and inversion require independently chosen tests and visual/anatomical review; no thresholds derived from current failing cuff output.

observed: Source shoulder/elbow/wrist landmarks estimated from muscle extents; no scanned skeletal centres.
4-second symmetric cosine phase and fixed chest tilt are authored timing/pose choices.
Scapula control rotations/translations are illustrative constants, not measured three-dimensional scapular kinematics.
Analytic fixed-length arm IK and a hand/bar offset do not validate tissue strain or shoulder articulation.
Current cuff weighting compression is a prototype concern for independent future deformation review, not a baseline to fit passing criteria.
currentUncalibratedAssumptions.scope: No production GLB, rig, runtime or historical review modified by this reference.

nextEvidenceNeeded: External variant-matched multi-view demonstration with timestamps and permission/license metadata.
Skeletal or manually reviewed attachment landmark annotations with uncertainty.
Separate scapular/humeral local frames and continuous upper-limb trajectory capture.
Original source-hand/palm contact and shoulder-cuff tissue continuity evidence in model metres.
Independent deformation-method comparison before choosing future maker implementation.
